notes: Owner's idea 2026-10-13: xunit.analyzers ships with every xunit reference. When a repo has it, `bro format` also applies its code fixes (e.g. xUnit2004 `Assert.Equal(true, x)` -> `Assert.True(x)`, xUnit2013 `Assert.Equal(0, list.Count)` -> `Assert.Empty(list)`), following the repo's own severities, like the Sonar support (off unless the repo's setup turns the rules on). Today format limits fixes to BRO + init's IDE/CA ids. Check which xUnit fixes support Fix All and converge in one run, and test on real xUnit repos. Done 2026-10-18 (owner's choices: an allowlist of fixes that keep each test's meaning, xUnit1025 and xUnit1048 included; nothing in init; the baseline covers them; v2 and v3 alike; docs/decisions/2026-10-18-which-xunit-fixes-bro-format-applies.md): `bro format` adds xUnit1014, 1025, 1048, 2000, 2003, 2004, 2006-2013, 2015, 2017, 2020, 2029-2031 to --diagnostics where the repository references xunit (FormatCommand.ReferencesXunit, BaselineSuppressor.XunitIds). Survey: CacheCow, Ardalis.Extensions, stateless (with xunit.analyzers 2.2.0) and a probe; maintained repositories had no xUnit warnings left. xUnit1013 put [Theory] on CacheCow's ILogger.Log, xUnit1030 failed a stateless test: both stay out. The assertion fixes cascade (2004 -> 2009/2017, 2010 -> 2000 -> 2013) and converge in two runs to the same text in every order.
